title: 10 Boring Businesses You Can Start Without Quitting Your Job
promo_conflict: Hosts sell a home service/remote cleaning program (Home Service Academy) and rank remote cleaning as a favourite

idea.name: Sprinkler startup and winterization routes
idea.one_liner: Twice-yearly irrigation spring start-up and autumn blow-out on neighbourhood routes, bundled into annual plans
idea.customer: homeowners with irrigation in cold climates

key_quotes.quote: Now, a winterization visit commonly runs about 50 to 150 bucks and then in in the spring to start it back up again is going to be another $60 to $125.
You can test this for around 500 to 2,000 bucks.

idea.name: Holiday light installation
idea.one_liner: Supply-and-install residential Christmas lights in a 10-12 week season, sold via door-to-door, yard signs and before/after Meta ads
idea.offer: holiday light design, install and takedown

key_quotes.quote: I actually ran one of these businesses before and did hundreds of [music] thousands of dollars in holiday light sales.
A full residential install [music] is going to run you, you know, $500 to $1,000 minimum for a normal house.

claims.claim: Ran a holiday lighting business with hundreds of thousands in sales and sold it
claims.quote: We sold that business and it still operates.

acquisition_channels.details: door to door, yard signs, flyers

idea.name: Pet waste removal routes
idea.one_liner: Weekly dog poop scooping at $15-30/visit on tight local routes, scaled with paid-per-job contractors

key_quotes.quote: A solo operator running a really tight route in a local area, let's say 125, 150 accounts per month, you're looking at about, you know, a 13 to over $16,000 a month business before you hire anybody.
I actually know people in this space that are doing two, three, $400,000 a month in sales, which is ridiculous.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Waste carrier registration needed to transport dog waste

idea.name: Mobile knife sharpening routes
idea.one_liner: Residential sharpening at $8-15/knife and recurring restaurant routes between lunch and dinner service

key_quotes.quote: Restaurants pay for a route typically 60 to $300 a month depending on how many knives you're sharpening.
Now, in doing my research, I found one guy who publicly said that a solid restaurant account can add $400 to $600 a month on a repeat schedule, which is pretty freaking good recurring revenue.

acquisition_channels.details: door to door to restaurants, farmers markets

idea.name: Dumpster pad cleaning
idea.one_liner: Degrease commercial dumpster pads and containers monthly/quarterly for property managers, capturing waste water
idea.customer: property managers of restaurants, grocery stores and apartments

key_quotes.quote: So pad cleaning will run about $50 to $200 a visit.
That's about $2,250 a month on a route you could run in a handful of mornings.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Discharging grease/wash water to surface drains is an offence; needs trade effluent consent or waste water collection and waste carrier licence

idea.name: Remote cleaning business with independent cleaners
idea.one_liner: Run a residential cleaning company from anywhere by dispatching independent cleaners who bring their own supplies and keeping 40-50% of each job; scale with online booking, automated texts and a VA
idea.revenue_model: 40-50% cut of each job; recurring clients

key_quotes.quote: And once you send them to that job, you keep a cut of what the client pays, typically around 40 to 50%.
The one I built for my mom crossed a million dollars in total sales.
About one in every three customers will tend to convert to a recurring customer, meaning get their home deep cleaned the first time.

claims.claim: Mom's cleaning business did $50K revenue last August
claims.quote: Last month did $50,000 of revenue in the month of August.

acquisition_channels.details: Google Local Services Ads, Facebook ads

ideas.delivery: independent cleaners with own supplies; online booking; automated texts; VA recruits cleaners and answers phones
ideas.other_uk_rules: Employment status risk (IR35/worker status) when using 'independent' cleaners under your brand

idea.name: Landscape lighting design and install
idea.one_liner: High-ticket low-voltage landscape lighting jobs averaging $3-4K, sold at dusk consultations and via landscaper/pool partnerships

key_quotes.quote: Even bigger than that, you get a mega mansion, you know, four to over 10 grand with an average job size, landing about 3 to 4K.
Again, leverage Facebook groups, but you know, partnerships with other home services like landscapers, pool companies are going to be amazing for you.

acquisition_channels.details: landscapers and pool companies with referral kickbacks

ideas.other_uk_rules: Outdoor electrical work may fall under Part P building regulations

idea.name: Drone roof imaging and inspections
idea.one_liner: Aerial roof documentation for roofers, insurance adjusters, solar installers and property managers at $120-600 per residential job
idea.offer: drone roof imagery and thermal mapping

key_quotes.quote: straightforward residential jobs commonly run about $120 to $600 based on my research depending on scope with commercial and thermal mapping um going way way beyond that.
But flying commercially in the United States requires an FAA part 107 certificate.

acquisition_channels.details: affiliate relationships with roofers, insurance agents, solar installers

ideas.other_uk_rules: CAA Operator ID, Flyer ID and A2 CofC/GVC for commercial drone flights; UK GDPR for imagery

idea.name: Parking lot litter cleanup
idea.one_liner: After-hours litter picking for commercial properties at $75-200/visit, sold through property managers; Brian Winch grew one past $1M/yr from a 1981 side hustle

key_quotes.quote: He started this as a side hustle around his full-time job back in 1981.
I mean, the common playbook in this industry is charge about 75 to 200 bucks per visit.

claims.quote: He's grown this business to do over a million dollars a year.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Waste carrier registration to transport collected litter

idea.name: Apartment valet trash service
idea.one_liner: Evening doorstep trash collection for apartment complexes paid per unit by the property manager ($8-18/unit/month) who bills residents $25-35

key_quotes.quote: Properties commonly pay the operator, that's you, eight to 18 bucks per unit per month, while separately billing residents 25 to $35 a month themselves.
Now, I found one of these businesses that are listed for sale that handles about a little over 1,500 units and they do about 15 grand a month in revenue.
